title: Scope and the TDZ

blocks.md:
## A name before it is ready

`let` and `const` exist in a temporal dead zone from the start of the block until the line that initializes them. Reading `label` above `let label = "east"` throws `ReferenceError`.

`var` is older and hoists as `undefined`. Prefer `let`/`const` so the crash teaches you.

blocks.promptMd: What happens if you `console.log(x)` on the line before `let x = 1` in the same block?
> `readyLabel()` returns `"east"` from a `let` that is initialized before you read it. Print it.

hintLadder.md: Declare, then assign or initialize, then return.

description: A name is only alive in its block. Using it too early is a fault.
